title: El castillo: Dirección y la Reina, fase a fase
description: docs/castle-bosses.md § Mar, Montse and Pilar, § La Reina Bubbaloo. Each phase of the two bosses from the fight tester's moments (Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost, the party holding on each round so the foes' turns show): Dirección's tells, the Acta signed and its Resolución, two left, Voto de calidad and En funciones; the Queen's layers, her hands and La Pompa, with the pegote it drips while it grows. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.foe = kind => ui.live.foes.find(f => f.kind === kind && f.hp > 0); window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z }, d || 4.2); }; window.called = name => { const el = document.querySelector('.move-callout'); return !!el && !el.hidden && [name, '«' + name + '»'].includes(el.querySelector('strong')?.textContent); }; window.hold = () => { const from = ui.live.round; let last = 0; window.held = false; const tick = () => { if (!ui.fight) return; if (ui.live.round > from && window.ready()) { window.held = true; return; } if (window.ready() && Date.now() - last > 1500) { last = Date.now(); window.cmd('defend'); } setTimeout(tick, 250); }; tick(); };
